user_story: As a user, I want to navigate through the multi-level navigation menu so that I can access different sections of the application easily. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When the user clicks on 'Main Item 1', the URL should not change and the text 'Main Item 1' should remain visible. 2. When the user clicks on 'Sub Item', the URL should not change and the text 'Sub Item' should remain visible.
